def remove(root, names):
    for name in names:
        (root / name).unlink()


async def process(root, name, rows, save):
    while True:
        (root / name).unlink()
        for row in rows:
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            await save(row)


async def stopped(root, names, rows, save):
    for name in names:
        (root / name).unlink()
        for row in rows:
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            await save(row)
        break


async def direct(root, names, save):
    for name in names:
        (root / name).unlink()
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await save(name)


async def once(load):
    for row in await load():
        print(row)


async def per_group(groups, load):
    for group in groups:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        for row in await load(group):
            print(row)
